sources.entry: Build A Job Scraping Web App

summary.title: How I built a job scraping web app using Node.js
summary.one_liner: Learn how to build a simple job listing web app in Node.js that fetches results from the Indreed job-scraping REST API using Axios and displays them with Express, Handlebars and MDL.
keywords: how to scrape jobs from indeed with node
takeaways: Set up a Node.js project with Express, Axios, express-handlebars and nodemon.
Call the Indreed REST API with Axios and loop over the JSON results in a Handlebars template.
Add a /search endpoint and form so users can filter job results by query and location (q and l parameters).
Ideas for extending the app: IP-based location with express-ip, more filters, authentication and caching.
summary.summary: The article walks through building a job listing web app in Node.js. It sets up an Express server with express-handlebars for templates, uses Axios to call the Indreed REST API (a scraping API for Indeed and other job sites), and renders title, summary and link for each job in MDL-styled cards. It then adds a /search endpoint with a form to filter by query and location, and closes with suggestions such as IP-based location, more filters, authentication and caching. The author notes that Indreed is in alpha and hosted on Heroku, and the page links to a code repository and live demo.
